text:
priyanka: :rotating_light: Pager fired — multiple customers reporting timeouts and gateway 5xx across US-east. Spikes started ~10:05 UTC. Seeing lots of 429s in front of the gateway too.
devon: I can see increased 429 counts from the rate limiter -> downstream gateways then produce 502/504. Checking rate-limit config pushes from last 30m.
ops_bot: Deploy event: rate-limiter-config v3.14 promoted by marco at 4311234500 — change: stricter tenant quotas for burst windows.
marco: that was me, short-term tweak to protect backend from noisy tenants. didn't expect cascade. rolling back now.
lina: timeline — ingress shows steady QPS then sudden token-bucket drops, 429s at edge, then backend worker pool saturates and starts returning 5xx.
priyanka: Priority: page oncall-sre. @oncall-sre can you take lead? (reaction :eyes:)
oncall-sre: taking. I'm switching on debugging mode for rate limiter and will open debug stream.
devon: logs — snippet:
```
[10:06:12] rate-limiter: tenant=acme tokens=0 burst=0 reqs=1200/s
[10:06:14] gateway: upstream_timeout backend=router-2 status=504
[10:06:15] proxy: returning 429 to client, X-RateLimit-Reset=3
```
marco: rolling config back to v3.13 now (command run). pushing to canary then all.
ops_bot: Rollout started: v3.13 -> 10% at 10:08, 100% at 10:11 (annotated)
lina: after rollback we see 429 drop-off but backend error rate still elevated — need to clear connection queue and restart one gateway pool if necessary.
priyanka: customer impact: several mid-size tenants saw increased latencies and degraded completions for ~6-15 mins. No data exposure. Support: flagging high-severity incidents with affected tenancy list.
devon: mitigation steps executed: 1) rollback rate-limit config 2) temporarily increased per-tenant burst for critical tenants (policy override) 3) rotated gateway worker pool to drain queued requests
marco: command used to bump burst for tenant org-123:
```
POST /admin/quota/override
{ "tenant": "org-123", "burst": 500 }
```
oncall-sre: after override and gateway pool restart, 5xx rate fell from 7% -> 0.6% in ~4 mins. Monitoring in progress. Holding page for another 20m.
lina: note: root cause appears to be an overly aggressive global burst clamp combined with a recent traffic pattern shift (large batch embedding requests). rate-limiter didn't account for short high-burst but legitimate jobs.
priyanka: action items during incident: - list affected tenants + severity for outreach - run postmortem to tighten deploy checklist for rate-limit changes - add automated rollout checks for 429->5xx cascade
marco: I'll add a safety guard: reject config pushes that reduce global burst below threshold OR require canary with synthetic traffic simulation.
devon: logs to attach for postmortem: rate-limiter logs, gateway logs, deploy timeline, metrics (P95 latency, 5xx rate) — linked in incident doc (placeholder link).
ops_bot: Incident: mitigation complete, monitoring mode enabled. Next check at 10:35.
priyanka: Notifying support and account teams to start proactive emails to affected customers. I'll draft copy.
oncall-sre: leaving a short runbook note: if similar pattern repeats, do emergency policy override then rollback deploy, then scale gateway pool. Tagging owners: @marco (rate-limiter), @lina (gateway), @devon (deploys).
marco: post-incident: will add automated canary traffic generator to test rate-limit changes pre-rollout.
priyanka: thanks team. closing the active page in 20m if metrics remain stable. Postmortem owners: priyanka + marco. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
